name: kimi-quota-statusline
description: Kimi Code TUI status line with official 5h and 7d quotas only
author: guo

interface.shortDescription: Official 5h and 7d quotas, cached for 90 seconds
interface.longDescription: Shows only official 5h and 7d quota bars in the Kimi terminal UI. No hooks, local server, session transcript access, token/cost accounting, or non-TUI requests. A short-lived refresh runs only while the TUI invokes the status line and shares a 90-second cache across terminals.
